HomePage.fieldTrialLabel: Field Trial 4: Lume Woreda, Central Highlands
HomePage.section4Subtitle: Designed specifically for the infrastructural realities and agronomic nuances of the Ethiopian agricultural landscape, from micro-plots to regional grain corridors.
HomePage.pillar1Summary: Delivers agronomic directives via natural voice in local languages, ensuring smallholders without digital literacy can receive and act on time-critical recommendations.
HomePage.pillar2Summary: Instant on-device and cloud diagnosis for over 48 endemic cereal diseases and invasive pests, operating seamlessly even during intermittent rural cellular connectivity.
HomePage.pillar2Prescription: Emergency Triazole spray within 48h before canopy spore saturation.
HomePage.pillar3Summary: Predictive micro-climate forecast engines calculate exact 6-hour windows for fertilizer absorption, spray efficacy, and harvest drying.
HomePage.pillar4Summary: Direct integration with regional cooperative unions and agro-dealers ensures access to verified, certified seeds and genuine crop protection inputs.
HomePage.section5Subtitle: For regions and smallholders without reliable smartphones or internet access, AgriIntel delivers automated voice broadcasts and direct alerts to local Kebele Development Agents.
HomePage.dispatch1Text: Delivered in Afan Oromo to 412 registered wheat farmers: 'High stripe rust risk detected. Postpone morning nitrogen spray until wind speed drops below 6 km/h.'
HomePage.dispatch2Text: Priority dispatch to 6 assigned Development Agents: 'Soil moisture saturation at 84% in Lower Valley. Direct furrow drainage protocol activated across 42 teff hectares.'
HomePage.dispatch3Text: Offline fallback sent to 1,280 smallholders with market price alerts for Adama grain depot and optimal 4-day harvest drying windows.

HomePage.benchmark3Desc: Zero sensor installation costs. Operates using existing satellite feeds, micro-weather radar, and basic mobile phones.
